SR2E.VRig98.gmOnly: Only a GM can do that.
SR2E.VRig98.alreadyDone: That card has already been applied.
SR2E.VRig98.refused: Refused: the card does not match its dice, its rigger or the rules now.
SR2E.VRig98.Chair.sits: {name} sits in the captain's chair, supervising the network (the control rig's Initiative counts; no Combat or Control Pool on drone tests).
SR2E.VRig98.Comprehension.ok: {name} understands the command ({successes} successes: the more, the more leeway it has).
SR2E.VRig98.Comprehension.fail: {name} does not understand the command and does not act on it.
SR2E.VRig98.Ecm.title: Electronic countermeasures: {name} scanning {target}
SR2E.VRig98.Ecm.jammed: {name}'s ECM wins: its Signature is {n} higher for this test.
SR2E.VRig98.Ecm.clear: No jamming: the scan goes ahead against the Signature of {name}.
SR2E.VRig98.Ed.label: ED
SR2E.VRig98.Ed.tip: Electronic deception: its rating in dice against a scanner's Sensor, +1 Signature per success (Rigger 2 p. 32, optional rule).
SR2E.VRig98.Sensor.r0: No contact: the sensors do not detect the target.
SR2E.VRig98.Sensor.r1: Basic contact: distance, direction of travel and speed, and the general type (a building, an aircraft, a ground vehicle, a living being).
SR2E.VRig98.Sensor.r2: General contact: the general subtype (a radar dish, a helicopter, a hovertank, a dragon).
SR2E.VRig98.Sensor.r3: Positive contact: the specific type (the model, the make, the kind of creature).
SR2E.VRig98.Sensor.r4: The features that tell the target apart from others of its type.
SR2E.VRig98.Missile.continuousOption: Continuous lock (+half Sensor to Intelligence; +2 on this vehicle's other Driving Tests this turn)
SR2E.VRig98.Missile.continuous: Continuous lock: +{dice} Intelligence dice; the gunner may attack nothing else until it strikes.
SR2E.VRig98.Missile.phase0: The missile strikes at the end of the Combat Turn (Combat Phase 0).
SR2E.VRig98.Mount.budget: Mount points: {used}/{budget} of the Body (hardpoint 2, firmpoint 1)
SR2E.VRig98.Mount.over: Mount points: {used}/{budget} of the Body: too many (a hardpoint takes 2, a firmpoint 1)
SR2E.VRig98.Mount.sheetOver: Mount points: {used} on the sheet, more than the Body's {budget} (a hardpoint takes 2, a firmpoint 1)
SR2E.VRig98.Tool.title: Rigging: Flux conditions
SR2E.VRig98.Tool.scene: Scene: {name}. The conditions change every remote link's Flux here (Rigger 2 p. 30).
SR2E.VRig98.Tool.hint: Humid air does not count with an electrical storm. Encryption (−0.5) and ECCM (−half) are read from the link and the vehicle.
SR2E.VRig98.Why.channel: That operation cannot hit that channel (meaconing: command or system; interference: system only).
SR2E.VRig98.Why.noRcd: A MIJI attack needs a remote control deck.
SR2E.VRig98.Why.noNetwork: The target has no remote control deck.
SR2E.VRig98.Why.noPem: Meaconing, intrusion and interference need a protocol emulation module (gear named with its rating, e.g. "Protocol Emulation Module 4").
SR2E.VRig98.Why.noEcm: Jamming needs ECM (a vehicle's ECM, or jammer gear).
SR2E.VRig98.Why.noEccm: Regenerating needs ECCM: the vehicle the deck rides in, or gear named with its rating (e.g. "ECCM 4").
SR2E.VRig98.Why.intercept: Intercept {name}'s network first (a link of one of its drones).
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.title: Electronic warfare: {name}
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.hint: The MIJI Test: your deck's Flux vs their deck's rating; they roll their deck's Flux vs your protocol emulation module (jamming: your ECM). Net successes are boxes on their Signal Monitor (Rigger 2 pp. 69–71).
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.noNetworks: There is no other rigger with a remote control deck.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.noDrone: {name} has no drone in their network to intercept.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.intruderRoll: {name}'s deck (Flux) vs the target deck's rating
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.defenderRoll: {name}'s deck (Flux) vs the intruder's module or ECM
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.hit: {boxes} boxes of degradation on the {channel} of {target}.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.held: {target}'s network holds: its channels stay clear.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.backfire: The interference fails: {boxes} boxes on {name}'s own system channel.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.gmLine: {name}'s MIJI Test (counted again from the card's dice): {boxes} boxes on the {channel} of {target}.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.lostEffect.command: The drones are cut off: they carry out their last command or hold where they are, acting only in self-defence; no commands until a box is regenerated.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.lostEffect.simsense: A rigger jumped into a drone through the deck suffers dump shock; no rigging through the deck until a box is regenerated.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.lostEffect.system: The intruder may take over what the channel controls (interference: the whole network); the loser suffers dump shock.
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.commandLost: {name}'s command channel is lost: the drones take no commands (regenerate it with ECCM).
SR2E.VRig98.Miji.simsenseLost: {name}'s simsense channel is lost: no rigging through the deck (regenerate it with ECCM).
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__rigWare: Control rig and other cyberware: move-by-wire lowers the rig's effective level and the Control Pool, an encephalon's Intelligence raises the rigged Reaction, Rigger 2 p. 17 (book) or neither (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__ecmTest: ECM: the opposed ECM Test (Flux vs Sensor, Flux vs ECM) raises the target's Signature by the jammer's successes, ECCM opposed, Rigger 2 p. 31 (book) or ECM beyond ECCM on the TN (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__ed: Electronic deception (optional): ED dice vs Sensor, +1 Signature per success, ECD negates and drains Flux, Rigger 2 p. 32 (book) or not used (off)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__sensorRes: Sensor Test results: what each number of successes tells, Rigger 2 p. 28 (book) or not shown (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__missiles: Missiles: strike at Combat Phase 0; continuous lock (+half Sensor to Intelligence, +2 on other Driving Tests) or fire-and-forget, Rigger 2 p. 59 (book) or neither (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__mountBudg: Weapon mounts share the Body: hardpoint 2 points, firmpoint 1, at most the Body, Rigger 2 p. 22 (book) or separate firmpoint and hardpoint counts (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__dronePhas: Network drones act in their rigger's Combat Phase, the rigger first, Rigger 2 p. 66 (book) or roll their own Initiative (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__comprehen: Comprehension Tests: a commanded drone rolls its Pilot (+ Non-Matrix Programming) vs the command's TN, +2 while the rigger runs a primary drone, Rigger 2 p. 66 (book) or no test (v971)
Comprehension Test TN when the GM sets none (Rigger 2 p. 66; average 4)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__captainsC: Captain's chair: a rigger supervising the network keeps the rig's Initiative, Rigger 2 p. 65 (book) or only when jumped in (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__flux: Flux and range: the scene's conditions, encryption and ECCM change a remote link's Flux (to the half), Rigger 2 p. 30 (book) or the plain Flux (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VRIG_V98__miji: MIJI: meaconing, intrusion, jamming and interference with Signal Monitors and ECCM regeneration, Rigger 2 pp. 69–72 (book) or the link spoof and jam roll (v971)
SR2E.Tools.rigging98.label: Rigging conditions (GM)
SR2E.Tools.rigging98.hint: Set the viewed scene's Flux conditions (high elevation, electrical storm, humid air, urban) for remote links (Rigger 2 p. 30).
